tickerText: [TENNIS] Shanghai Masters: Zizou Bergs stunned Carlos Alcaraz 7-5, 7-6(4), locking in Alexander Zverev as 2026 year-end world No. 1 • [SQUASH] CIB Egyptian Open quarter-finals move to the Pyramids—Nouran Gohar and Nour ElSherbini set a Cairo clash after round-three wins • [BADMINTON] VICTOR Denmark Open Super 750 begins in Odense as withdrawals reshuffle the draw for An Se-young, P. V. Sindhu and Victor Lai • [PICKLEBALL] Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open: senior open and pro qualifying Tuesday while the WALKER Australia Pickleball Cup opens in Brisbane • [TABLE TENNIS] Wang Manyu regains women's world No. 1 after defending WTT China Smash with a 4-0 final over Hitomi Sato; Sora Matsushima stays atop the men

newsItems.title: Bergs Stuns Alcaraz in Shanghai
newsItems.excerpt: Belgium's Zizou Bergs beat Carlos Alcaraz 7-5, 7-6(4) at the Rolex Shanghai Masters, helping Alexander Zverev secure the ATP year-end No. 1 ranking.

newsItems.title: Denmark Open Begins in Odense
newsItems.excerpt: The VICTOR Denmark Open Super 750 kicks off in Odense with draw changes after withdrawals, setting up An Se-young vs Polina Buhrova and P. V. Sindhu vs Yvonne Li.

newsItems.title: Virginia Beach Qualifying Day
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Tour's Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open continues with senior open play and pro qualifying Tuesday as the parallel Australia Cup starts in Brisbane.

newsItems.title: Wang Back to World No. 1
newsItems.excerpt: China's Wang Manyu returned to the top of the ITTF women's rankings after sweeping Hitomi Sato 4-0 to defend her WTT China Smash title in Beijing.
